title: services: create_world (full world, bots, spawns)
criteria:
Replace the Phase 0 body of `create_world` in realm/services/worlds.py with the full version (BUILD.md 8.8 + T10); keep the same signature, keep current_world/world_now/pause/resume unchanged, and keep the existing validation (unknown tribe or speed not in (1,3,5,10) -> GameError INVALID_TARGET).
Steps: end all running worlds; insert the World; tiles = worldgen.generate_tiles(seed, cfg) and bulk insert them with `s.execute(insert(Tile), rows)` where each row is a dict {world_id, x, y, kind (TileKind value string), layout, oasis_type}; choose bots with rng = random.Random(seed): for each of bot_count bots `rng.choices` a personality key by cfg.personalities[*].share and a difficulty key by cfg.difficulty_shares; positions = worldgen.pick_spawns(tiles, seed, [cfg.bot_difficulties[d].spawn_min_radius for each bot], cfg) -> (player_pos, bot_positions); human Player at player_pos with a village whose layout is that tile's layout and whose name is f'บ้านของ{player_name}'; each bot: Player(is_bot True, tribe = rng.choice(sorted(cfg.tribes)), production_mult = cfg.bot_difficulties[difficulty].production_mult, name = unique Thai name from realm.core.names.BOT_NAMES (take rng.sample of names; when bot_count exceeds the list append ' 2', ' 3' ... to repeat names so names stay unique within the world), same name used for its village, is_capital True, the layout of its tile), a BotProfile(player_id, personality, difficulty, next_think_at = game_epoch + timedelta(seconds=rng.uniform(0, think_interval_min * 60 / speed)), memory {}); every village gets cfg.world.start_resources, res_updated_at = game_epoch and its buildings from slots.initial_buildings(layout, cfg); all players get protection_until = game_epoch + protection_hours*3600/speed, cp_updated_at/created_at = game_epoch, capital_village_id set; finally schedule ROUND_END (events.schedule at ends_at, payload {}). Insert players/villages/buildings with add_all/flush in reasonable batches (no per-row queries in loops).
Tests in tests/services/test_create_world.py (fixtures `s`, `cfg`, `t0`):
- create_world(seed=42, speed=1, bot_count=30, tribe stonehold): 10201 tile rows; 31 players (1 human, 30 bots) each with exactly 1 village; 30 bot_profiles; player village at (0,0) with name 'บ้านของผู้เล่น' (player_name 'ผู้เล่น'); every village stands on a valley tile whose layout equals the village layout; pairwise village distance >= 3 (torus distance computed in the test with size 101); every bot village marked hard (profile.difficulty 'hard') is >= 15 from (0,0); easy >= 5 and normal >= 8; all bot names unique and taken from BOT_NAMES; every bot has production_mult equal to the YAML value for its difficulty (hard 1.2, others 1.0); next_think_at of each bot lies in [game_epoch, game_epoch + think_interval_min*60 seconds] at speed 1.
- determinism: two worlds created with the same seed in the same test (second one after the first, same cfg) have identical tile tuples (x,y,kind,layout,oasis_type) sorted, identical bot positions, names, personalities and difficulties.
- bot_count=0 works (only the human).
- bot_count=70 -> still 70 unique names.
- performance: create_world with seed 42 and 30 bots takes under 5 seconds (time.perf_counter).
- the personality mix over bot_count=200 bots with seed 1 is within 8 percentage points of cfg shares (farmer 35%, turtle 20%, raider 20%, expander 15%, warlord 10%) and the difficulty mix within 8 points of 40/45/15.
- ROUND_END event exists with due_at == world.ends_at.
Update tests/services/test_worlds.py only where Phase 0 assumptions broke: the tile count is now 10201 (not 1), tiles are all inserted for any bot_count, and with bot_count=0 there is still exactly 1 player and 1 village; the village name is now 'บ้านของ<ชื่อ>' if any assertion mentions it. Keep every other assertion.
notes:
- bulk insert: from sqlalchemy import insert; s.execute(insert(Tile), rows). Use plain dict rows (no ORM objects) for tiles.
- TileSpec has x, y, kind (TileKind enum), layout, oasis_type. layout lookup for a position: build a dict {(x, y): TileSpec}.
- The human Player is created first, then bots in order; ids come from flush.
- Use `cfg.bot_difficulties`, `cfg.difficulty_shares`, `cfg.personalities` (key -> PersonalityDef with .share). Sort dict keys where determinism matters (use list(cfg.personalities) in YAML order for choices).
- Do not change realm/api or the CLI; their default bot_count stays as is.
- Thai: the only Thai strings are the village name f'บ้านของ{player_name}' and error messages already in the file; copy them exactly, do not retype others.
- Do not commit; do not call datetime.now().
